description: Source Requirement Matrix for AET-KP-UL-SCAPULA-001 candidate facts and clinical/topographic connections, specifying required source categories without fabricating unregistered source IDs.

GROSS_ANATOMY_TEXTBOOK.description: Primary authoritative gross anatomical treatises covering osteology, borders, surfaces, angles, processes, articular surfaces, and muscle attachments.
GROSS_ANATOMY_TEXTBOOK.minimum_support_needed: Chapter, section, and page level citation establishing primary skeletal morphology and muscular origin/insertion footprints.

REGIONAL_ANATOMY_TEXTBOOK.description: Specialized regional anatomical works focusing on complex syntopic relationships, axillary borders, triangular and quadrangular spaces, and neurovascular courses.
REGIONAL_ANATOMY_TEXTBOOK.minimum_support_needed: Precise dimensional description of fascial spaces, bounding muscles, passing nerves, and collateral vascular anastomoses.

CLINICAL_ANATOMY_TEXTBOOK.description: Clinically oriented anatomy literature detailing surgical anatomy, entrapment syndromes, nerve injury presentations, and biomechanical stability.
CLINICAL_ANATOMY_TEXTBOOK.minimum_support_needed: Peer-reviewed clinical textbook citation confirming pathological mechanisms (e.g. serratus palsy/long thoracic injury, suprascapular entrapment).

TERMINOLOGY_AUTHORITY.description: Official international morphological nomenclature standard (e.g. FIPAT IFAA Terminologia Anatomica 2).
TERMINOLOGY_AUTHORITY.minimum_support_needed: Unique alphanumeric standard identifier (e.g. TA2 code) with Latin official term, English equivalent, and sanctioned PT-BR translation.

ANATOMICAL_ATLAS.description: Dissection-based photographic and illustrated cadaveric atlases providing multi-angle visual verification of orientation criteria and syntopic relations.
ANATOMICAL_ATLAS.minimum_support_needed: Plate citation demonstrating isolated bone orientation (spine posterior, glenoid lateral) and dissected posterior shoulder topography.

3D_MODEL_METADATA.description: Rigorous volumetric polygon mesh or CT-derived segmented 3D dataset defining anatomical surface nodes and spatial coordinate systems.
3D_MODEL_METADATA.minimum_support_needed: Documented 3D model manifest identifying mesh node IDs and spatial coordinate bounds for landmark marker positioning.
